1	import {
2	  boolean,
3	  index,
4	  integer,
5	  jsonb,
6	  pgTable,
7	  primaryKey,
8	  smallint,
9	  text,
10	  time,
11	  timestamp,
12	  uniqueIndex,
13	  uuid,
14	} from "drizzle-orm/pg-core";
15	
16	// Admin users (owner or staff member with a login). Clients don't log in.
17	export const users = pgTable("users", {
18	  id: uuid("id").primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
19	  email: text("email").notNull().unique(),
20	  passwordHash: text("password_hash").notNull(),
21	  name: text("name").notNull(),
22	  role: text("role", { enum: ["owner", "staff"] }).notNull().default("staff"),
23	  businessId: uuid("business_id").references(() => businesses.id),
24	  createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
25	});
26	
27	export const businesses = pgTable("businesses", {
28	  id: uuid("id").primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
29	  slug: text("slug").notNull().unique(),
30	  name: text("name").notNull(),
31	  timezone: text("timezone").notNull().default("Asia/Almaty"),
32	  currency: text("currency").notNull().default("KZT"),
33	  // How long a picked slot is held in Redis before checkout expires
34	  holdTtlSec: integer("hold_ttl_sec").notNull().default(300),
35	  createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
36	});
37	
38	// Opening hours per ISO weekday (1 = Monday … 7 = Sunday). No row = closed.
39	export const businessHours = pgTable(
40	  "business_hours",
41	  {
42	    id: uuid("id").primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
43	    businessId: uuid("business_id").notNull().references(() => businesses.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
44	    weekday: smallint("weekday").notNull(), // 1-7 ISO
45	    openTime: time("open_time").notNull(), // local wall time, e.g. 09:00
46	    closeTime: time("close_time").notNull(),
47	  },
48	  (t) => [uniqueIndex("business_hours_unique").on(t.businessId, t.weekday)],
49	);
50	
51	export const staff = pgTable("staff", {
52	  id: uuid("id").primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
53	  businessId: uuid("business_id").notNull().references(() => businesses.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
54	  userId: uuid("user_id").references(() => users.id), // optional login for this master
55	  name: text("name").notNull(),
56	  isActive: boolean("is_active").notNull().default(true),
57	  createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
58	});
59	
60	// Personal schedule overriding business hours. No rows = inherits business hours.
61	export const staffHours = pgTable(
62	  "staff_hours",
63	  {
64	    id: uuid("id").primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
65	    staffId: uuid("staff_id").notNull().references(() => staff.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
66	    weekday: smallint("weekday").notNull(), // 1-7 ISO
67	    startTime: time("start_time").notNull(),
68	    endTime: time("end_time").notNull(),
69	  },
70	  (t) => [uniqueIndex("staff_hours_unique").on(t.staffId, t.weekday)],
71	);
72	
73	export const services = pgTable("services", {
74	  id: uuid("id").primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
75	  businessId: uuid("business_id").notNull().references(() => businesses.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
76	  name: text("name").notNull(),
77	  durationMin: integer("duration_min").notNull(),
78	  priceKzt: integer("price_kzt").notNull(),
79	  isActive: boolean("is_active").notNull().default(true),
80	});
81	
82	// Which masters perform which services (M:N)
83	export const staffServices = pgTable(
84	  "staff_services",
85	  {
86	    staffId: uuid("staff_id").notNull().references(() => staff.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
87	    serviceId: uuid("service_id").notNull().references(() => services.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
88	  },
89	  (t) => [primaryKey({ columns: [t.staffId, t.serviceId] })],
90	);
91	
92	export const clients = pgTable(
93	  "clients",
94	  {
95	    id: uuid("id").primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
96	    businessId: uuid("business_id").notNull().references(() => businesses.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
97	    name: text("name").notNull(),
98	    phone: text("phone").notNull(),
99	    email: text("email"),
100	    createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
101	  },
102	  (t) => [uniqueIndex("clients_business_phone_unique").on(t.businessId, t.phone)],
103	);
104	
105	export const bookingStatuses = ["confirmed", "completed", "cancelled", "no_show"] as const;
106	export type BookingStatus = (typeof bookingStatuses)[number];
107	
108	// Overlap protection lives in the DB too: an EXCLUDE USING gist constraint on
109	// (staff_id, tstzrange(start_at, end_at)) WHERE status = 'confirmed' is added
110	// in a hand-written migration — Redis holds are the first line, this is the last.
111	export const bookings = pgTable("bookings", {
112	  id: uuid("id").primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
113	  businessId: uuid("business_id").notNull().references(() => businesses.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
114	  staffId: uuid("staff_id").notNull().references(() => staff.id),
115	  serviceId: uuid("service_id").notNull().references(() => services.id),
116	  clientId: uuid("client_id").notNull().references(() => clients.id),
117	  startAt: timestamp("start_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull(),
118	  endAt: timestamp("end_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull(),
119	  status: text("status", { enum: bookingStatuses }).notNull().default("confirmed"),
120	  priceKzt: integer("price_kzt").notNull(), // snapshot of service price at booking time
121	  note: text("note"),
122	  createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
123	});
124	
125	export const waitlistStatuses = ["waiting", "offered", "booked", "expired", "cancelled"] as const;
126	
127	/**
128	 * A client who wants a day that is already full. When a booking is cancelled
129	 * the freed slot is offered down this queue, oldest entry first, each offer
130	 * held for a limited time before it moves on.
131	 */
132	export const waitlistEntries = pgTable(
133	  "waitlist_entries",
134	  {
135	    id: uuid("id").primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
136	    businessId: uuid("business_id").notNull().references(() => businesses.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
137	    serviceId: uuid("service_id").notNull().references(() => services.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
138	    // null = any master who performs the service
139	    staffId: uuid("staff_id").references(() => staff.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
140	    clientId: uuid("client_id").notNull().references(() => clients.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
141	    dateISO: text("date_iso").notNull(), // local date at the business, YYYY-MM-DD
142	    status: text("status", { enum: waitlistStatuses }).notNull().default("waiting"),
143	    // Set while an offer is outstanding
144	    offerToken: text("offer_token"),
145	    // Redis hold reserving the slot for this client while the offer stands
146	    offerHoldToken: text("offer_hold_token"),
147	    offerSlotStartAt: timestamp("offer_slot_start_at", { withTimezone: true }),
148	    offerSlotEndAt: timestamp("offer_slot_end_at", { withTimezone: true }),
149	    offerExpiresAt: timestamp("offer_expires_at", { withTimezone: true }),
150	    offerStaffId: uuid("offer_staff_id").references(() => staff.id, { onDelete: "set null" }),
151	    createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
152	  },
153	  (t) => [
154	    uniqueIndex("waitlist_offer_token_unique").on(t.offerToken),
155	    index("waitlist_queue_idx").on(t.businessId, t.dateISO, t.status, t.createdAt),
156	  ],
157	);
158	
159	export const outboxStatuses = ["pending", "processing", "sent", "dead", "cancelled"] as const;
160	
161	/**
162	 * Transactional outbox. Rows are written in the same transaction as the
163	 * business change they describe, so a booking and its confirmation can never
164	 * disagree about whether they happened. A worker drains them separately.
165	 */
166	export const outbox = pgTable(
167	  "outbox",
168	  {
169	    id: uuid("id").primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
170	    businessId: uuid("business_id").notNull().references(() => businesses.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
171	    topic: text("topic").notNull(), // booking.confirmed, booking.reminder, waitlist.offer, …
172	    payload: jsonb("payload").notNull(),
173	    // Natural key of the thing this message is about. Lets callers enqueue
174	    // idempotently and cancel a scheduled message that is no longer wanted.
175	    dedupeKey: text("dedupe_key"),
176	    availableAt: timestamp("available_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
177	    status: text("status", { enum: outboxStatuses }).notNull().default("pending"),
178	    attempts: integer("attempts").notNull().default(0),
179	    maxAttempts: integer("max_attempts").notNull().default(5),
180	    lastError: text("last_error"),
181	    createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
182	    updatedAt: timestamp("updated_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
183	  },
184	  (t) => [
185	    uniqueIndex("outbox_dedupe_key_unique").on(t.dedupeKey),
186	    index("outbox_claim_idx").on(t.status, t.availableAt),
187	  ],
188	);
189	
190	/** Everything a channel actually delivered — the demo's stand-in for an ESP. */
191	export const messageLog = pgTable("message_log", {
192	  id: uuid("id").primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
193	  businessId: uuid("business_id").notNull().references(() => businesses.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
194	  outboxId: uuid("outbox_id").references(() => outbox.id, { onDelete: "set null" }),
195	  channel: text("channel", { enum: ["email", "sms"] }).notNull(),
196	  recipient: text("recipient").notNull(),
197	  subject: text("subject").notNull(),
198	  body: text("body").notNull(),
199	  createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
200	});
201	
202	export const auditLog = pgTable("audit_log", {
203	  id: uuid("id").primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
204	  businessId: uuid("business_id").notNull().references(() => businesses.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
205	  actorUserId: uuid("actor_user_id").references(() => users.id),
206	  action: text("action").notNull(), // e.g. booking.create, booking.cancel, service.update
207	  entity: text("entity").notNull(),
208	  entityId: uuid("entity_id"),
209	  meta: jsonb("meta"),
210	  createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
211	});

The note field is in place end to end: step 4 of the booking wizard, the public booking API, the `createBooking` write path, and the admin calendar card. Unit tests, lint and `pnpm build` pass; I couldn't run the new integration test or an axe check, since Postgres and Redis aren't running here.

- **Booking page:** a textarea labelled "Note (optional)" with a `0/500` counter, linked via `aria-describedby`. The label text is `zinc-500` so it meets WCAG AA contrast on white.
- **API (`/api/public/[slug]/book`):** accepts an optional `note`. A raw value over 500 characters returns `400 bad_request` before anything is created.
- **Storage (`src/lib/booking.ts`):** the note is trimmed, and blank becomes `NULL`. Inner line breaks are kept. The column already existed, so there's no migration. The waitlist path still calls `createBooking` without a note, which stays valid.
- **Admin calendar (`src/app/admin/page.tsx`):** the note appears as its own line on the card, rendered as plain text with `whitespace-pre-wrap` so line breaks show.
- **Test:** added a case to `booking.integration.test.ts` covering trimming, inner line breaks and blank-to-`NULL`.

One judgement call: the 500-character limit applies to the raw submitted string, before trimming. This matches the field's `maxLength`, so a note with padding whitespace can't exceed 500 characters even before trimming.

`tsc --noEmit` reports one error in `src/app/layout.tsx` (`LayoutProps`). It's a generated type I didn't touch, and the build passes regardless.
